propositions: CodeHealthConfig.analyzers field is never read outside config plumbing and advertises a non-functional analyzer selection capability

The per-language analyzer dispatch (ANALYZERS registry, resolve_analyzer, analyze_or_unavailable) was designed in epic 839b but intentionally left empty and never wired; story c23c-c32b-982c-4196 sanctioned removal but the deletion was conditional prose rather than an acceptance criterion so it was never executed

The seam is not viable as designed: analyze_or_unavailable calls analyzer.analyze(repo_root, languages=languages) by keyword but scc_loc.analyze's second parameter is named scan_roots, causing TypeError at runtime
The live analyzer composition path in git_metrics.py (_scc_analysis, _lizard_analysis, _jscpd_analysis) bypasses the dispatch entirely and uses language-agnostic adapters directly
load_lizard function is dead code that duplicates the guard lizard_complexity.analyze already performs
Removing the config key requires adding tombstone entries to _TOMBSTONE_REGISTRY to prevent silent drops and warn users of the deprecated field
